title: Supporting data for a genome-scale, hypothesis-guided survey of protein candidates relevant to sulfur metabolism and volatile chemistry in Cannabis sativa
description: Query definitions, search assignments, staged validation results, retained candidate sequences, expression cross-references, and PF01053 phylogenetic artifacts supporting a survey of Cannabis sativa protein candidates.
references: Barbosa-Xavier et al. (2024), Cannabis Expression Atlas, https://doi.org/10.1111/ppl.70010
